description_ru: Поездка на поезде по горам Швейцарии: виды, погода и сыр.
text:
Last winter, I took a famous train through the mountains of Switzerland. The journey was nine hours long, and it was the most beautiful trip of my life.

The train was slow, but that was good, because we had time to look out of the big windows. We crossed high bridges, passed dark forests and went through long tunnels. Outside, everything was white. Small wooden houses stood in the snow, and thin smoke rose from their chimneys.

At lunchtime, I walked to the restaurant car and ordered a hot cheese dish. It was delicious, and it was much cheaper than the food at the airport. A young couple from Brazil sat at my table, and we talked about our countries.

When the train arrived at the last station, the sun was already going down. The mountains turned pink, and I took one hundred photographs. I am going to go again next year.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Округлите губы, как для «у», и быстро раскройте; зубы не касаются губы, не «в».
Кончик языка слегка между зубами, выдыхайте воздух без голоса; не заменяйте на «с» или «ф».
Кончик языка поднят и не касается нёба, губы чуть округлены; не раскатистое русское «р».
